breadcrumb: Std 7 Social Science Term-II (English) — Civics Unit 1: State Government — Boxed notes (தெரிந்து தெளிவோம் / Do you know)

questions.quote: First English fortress in India. The fort currently houses the Tamil Nadu legislative assembly and Secretariat of Tamilnadu.

en.q: The first English fortress in India, now housing the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly and the Secretariat, is ______.
en.explanation: Legislative Assembly has the lower house where all the MLAs meet to discuss matters related to the welfare of the state.

ta.q: இந்தியாவின் முதல் ஆங்கிலக் கோட்டையும், தற்போது தமிழ்நாட்டுச் சட்டமன்றமும் தலைமைச் செயலகமும் செயல்படும் இடமுமான கோட்டை ______.
ta.explanation: சட்டமன்றத்தின் கீழவையில் மாநில நலன் தொடர்பான விஷயங்களை விவாதிக்க அனைத்து உறுப்பினர்களும் கூடுகின்றனர்.

questions.quote: 28 states and 8 union territories including our capital territory Delhi... power is divided between two sets of governments one at the central in Delhi and separate governments for all the states. This is called as federal system.

en.q: The system in which power is divided between the central government and separate state governments is called the ______ system.
en.explanation: India is a Parliamentary democratic republic.

ta.q: மத்திய அரசுக்கும் தனித்தனி மாநில அரசுகளுக்கும் இடையே அதிகாரம் பகிரப்படும் முறை ______ முறை எனப்படும்.

questions.quote: MLAs are not appointed. They are elected by the people through general election... All the people residing in that constituency who has completed 18 years of age cast their vote. The Election Commission of India conducts and monitors the elections.

en.q: Members of the Legislative Assembly (MLAs) are ______.
options: Elected by the people through general election
en.explanation: The candidate who gets the most votes in a constituency is declared elected.

ta.explanation: தொகுதியில் அதிக வாக்குகள் பெற்றவர் வெற்றி பெற்றவராக அறிவிக்கப்படுகிறார்.

questions.quote: The Governor is appointed by the president of India for the term of five years. The leader of the majority party is appointed as the Chief Minister by the Governor. The term of the office is five years.

en.q: The term of office of a Chief Minister (and of the Legislative Assembly) is ______ years.
en.explanation: The Governor is appointed by the President for a term of five years.

ta.explanation: ஆளுநரும் குடியரசுத் தலைவரால் ஐந்து ஆண்டுகளுக்கு நியமிக்கப்படுகிறார்.

questions.quote: Why not? To become a Governor... To become a Chief Minister, you should have completed 25 years of age and should be an MLA or in case of an MLC should have completed 30 years of age.

en.q: To become a Chief Minister, one should have completed ______ years of age and be an MLA.
en.explanation: In the case of an MLC, one should have completed 30 years of age.

ta.q: முதலமைச்சராக ______ வயது நிறைந்தவராகவும் சட்டமன்ற உறுப்பினராகவும் இருக்க வேண்டும்.
ta.explanation: மேலவை உறுப்பினர் எனில் 30 வயது நிறைந்திருக்க வேண்டும்.

questions.quote: Usually a state Legislature has two houses. Upper House and Lower House. This is called Bi-cameral Legislature. Upper House is called Legislative Council... In Tamil Nadu we have Lower House only. This is called unicameral Legislature.

en.q: The Upper House of a state legislature is called the ______.
en.explanation: Tamil Nadu has only the Legislative Assembly, a unicameral legislature.

ta.explanation: தமிழ்நாட்டில் சட்டப்பேரவை மட்டுமே உள்ளது; இது ஓரவை சட்டமன்றம்.

questions.quote: The Governor... He is the chancellor of Government universities in the state. All bills become law only after his assent. He appoints important officials of the state government such as advocate General, Chairman and members of State Public Service Commission, State Election Commissioner, Vice chancellors of state universities etc.

en.q: Who is the chancellor of the government universities in a state?
en.explanation: All bills become law only after the Governor's assent.

ta.explanation: அனைத்து மசோதாக்களும் ஆளுநரின் ஒப்புதலுக்குப் பின்பே சட்டமாகின்றன.

questions.quote: The Chief Minister is the real executive head of the state administration. He allocates the portfolios among the ministers. The Council of Ministers are collectively responsible to the State Legislature.

en.q: The real executive head of the state administration is the ______.
en.explanation: The Council of Ministers is collectively responsible to the Legislative Assembly.

questions.quote: The High court consists of a Chief Justice and other judges. President appoints the Chief Justice and can hold the office until he completes the age of 62 years. Family Courts are established to settle the disputes relating to marriages and family affairs.

en.q: The Chief Justice of a High Court holds office until he completes the age of ______ years.
en.explanation: The President appoints the Chief Justice.

ta.q: உயர் நீதிமன்றத் தலைமை நீதிபதி ______ வயது நிறைவடையும் வரை பதவியில் இருப்பார்.
